cohort: 610 lactating mothers in Legambo district, South Wollo Zone, North East Ethiopia
finding: The prevalence of breast problems among postnatal lactating women was 54.3%, with significant associations found for primiparity, preterm infant, home delivery, ineffective breastfeeding techniques, caesarean section delivery, and mixed type of feeding.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery and home delivery were significantly associated with breast problems.
